title: Hunts x0.5 in the eval, x1.0 once funded
question: ATLAS 2026-10-30 b: can a stage-aware member set (extra members by eval session / room / funded stage) keep the hunts' and the NA lead's money without breaking the 25K eval?
verdict: Hunts x0.5 in the eval (atlas-v2 lead) + x1.0 once funded: passes; 6 of 8 neighbours (x0.6 in the eval fails H2 by 1 stuck eval); the real H2 path never passes its Jul-1 eval. Same hunt caveats. H1: 2-week pass/dead 67.2/0.0, eval-path $1,655/mo less fees, slot $758/mo to the owner net of evals, 7.19 trades/wk; H2: 2-week pass/dead 55.1/0.0, eval-path $665/mo less fees, slot $595/mo to the owner net of evals, 7.31 trades/wk; 2021-25: 2-week pass/dead 25.0/23.9, eval-path $-4/mo less fees, slot $30/mo to the owner net of evals, 9.3 trades/wk. Real-session slot (one path from each span's first session): H1 $766/mo (6 payouts, 2 evals); H2 $-34/mo (0 payouts, 2 evals); 2025 $66/mo (2 payouts, 10 evals); 2021-24 $-7/mo (2 payouts, 29 evals)
notes: tools/atx_edge.py (slot = 300 block-bootstrap paths x 126 sessions, $63 evals, 80% payouts)

sizing.eval: engine/account_b.qty need (tools/atlas.q_variant) x the member weight / schedule
sizing.funded: engine/sizing.funded_qty on the 25K preset (60% room, $50-$750, ref 20, winner <= $1,000) x the member weight (<= 1)
